title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
title_zh: Coda-DaVinci：用 Code2Video 重新构想视频生成
abstract_en: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.
abstract_zh: Code2Video 利用智能体编写的 3D 代理模型引导视频生成，从而显式控制场景结构与运动，但如何设计代理模型和提示词以获得更好的生成效果，仍缺乏系统研究。本文通过受控实验和盲评，考察代理模型粒度、物理模拟和提示词的作用。结果表明，代理模型粒度的取舍因任务而异：粗粒度更有利于运动自然，中等粒度更有利于保持一致性；物理模拟和与代理模型对齐的提示词则能进一步提升平均生成质量。基于这些发现，作者提出任务自适应的智能体框架 Coda-DaVinci，在代理引导生成和直接生成之间选择，按实体调整建模粒度，并协调物理模拟与基于代理模型的提示词。其多智能体机制保留场景资产，并通过视觉检查和独立复核指导修正。实验显示，该框架在 VTR 的指令遵循和 R2M 的场景一致性上表现领先，生成结果比直接生成更符合物理规律，也比所比较的 Code2Video 基线更逼真。长视频评估显示，事件结构和连续交互的一致性有所改善，但转场稳定性和场景设定遵循仍有不足。
key_points_zh: 受控实验与盲评表明，代理模型并非越精细越好：粗粒度更利于自然运动，中等粒度更利于一致性。
物理模拟和与代理模型对齐的提示词均能提升平均生成质量。
Coda-DaVinci 按任务选择代理引导或直接生成，按实体调整建模粒度，并通过多智能体视觉检查和独立复核指导修正。
VTR 指令遵循与 R2M 场景一致性表现领先；相较直接生成更符合物理规律，相较所比较的 Code2Video 基线更逼真。
长视频的事件结构和连续交互一致性有所改善，但转场稳定性与场景设定遵循仍有不足。

Visual feedback. Visual inspection covers both the proxy and the generated video. For code2video
